title: Progressive chromosome shape changes during cell divisions.
authors: Kakui, Yasutaka; Kusano, Yoshiharu; Clarence, Tereza; Lopez, Maya; Fallesen, Todd; Hirota, Toru; Khatri, Bhavin S; Uhlmann, Frank
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有丝分裂染色体形态变化与凝聚素介导的染色质环捕获模型，虽涉及DNA结构模拟但非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且方法为粗粒化模拟而非AI/分子动力学，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Mitotic chromosomes give genome portions the required compaction and mechanical stability for faithful inheritance during cell divisions. They are shaped by the chromosomal condensin complex. Here, we record human chromosome dimensions from their appearance in prophase over successive times in a mitotic arrest. Chromosomes first appear long and uniformly thin. Then, individual chromosome arms become discernible, which continuously shorten and thicken-the longer a chromosome arm, the thicker it becomes. In the search for a molecular explanation of this behavior, given uniform condensin density, the popular loop extrusion model provides no obvious means by which longer chromosome arms become thicker. Instead, we find that simulations of an alternative loop capture model recapitulate key features of our observations, with re-arranging chromatin rosettes underpinning the gradually developing arm length-to-width relationship. Our analyses portray chromosomes as out-of-equilibrium structures in the process of transitioning towards, but on biologically relevant time scales not typically reaching, steady state.
abstract_zh: 有丝分裂染色体赋予基因组部分所需的压实和机械稳定性，以确保细胞分裂过程中的忠实遗传。它们由染色体凝缩蛋白复合体塑造。在此，我们记录了人类染色体从前期出现到有丝分裂阻滞期间连续时间点的尺寸变化。染色体最初表现为长而均匀纤细的形态。随后，单个染色体臂变得可辨别，并持续缩短和增粗——染色体臂越长，其变得越粗。在寻找这一行为的分子解释时，鉴于凝缩蛋白密度均匀，流行的环挤压模型未提供明显机制来解释为何较长的染色体臂会变得更粗。相反，我们发现，一种替代性环捕获模型的模拟重现了我们观察到的关键特征，其中染色质玫瑰花结的重排支撑了逐渐发展的臂长与宽度关系。我们的分析将染色体描绘为非平衡结构，它们正处于向稳态过渡的过程中，但在生物学相关时间尺度上通常未达到稳态。
